name: legacy_reasoning
use_case: HISTORICAL ONLY. The shape behind the headline throughput figures in the published reports.
rationale: A 41-token input represents no real workload. Retained so the shape of the published figures stays explicit instead of being reconstructed from source. Treat those numbers as node capacity under a synthetic best case: on one measured configuration, raising input to 13k tokens moved time-to-first-token from 71 ms to 2.58 s on the same server.
duplicate_note: These indices repeat an earlier prompt verbatim, on purpose. With prefix caching OFF they are indistinguishable from any other prompt. With it ON they are the only prompts able to hit the cache, which is how to measure the caching effect without contaminating the uncached figure.
